system.description:
You aim your weapon and coat it in a twisting chakra that and then becomes a pair of dragons

that spiral around each other when you Fire, expanding until the weapon is completely obscured. All creatures in 15 feet wide line with a maximum length equal to your weapons Range, originating from you, must make a Dexterity saving throw taking [Weapons damage] + 7d10 on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

Chain 3: After firing all creatures who fail their saving throw has their movement speed reduced to 0 until the beginning of your next turn and you can shift your Chain rank to any value other than 0 if you choose.
